decision_rationale: JPEG quality 95 was selected because it preserved high whole-image and bbox-ROI fidelity, passed geometry and bbox invariance validation, and reduced projected storage by approximately 49% relative to quality 100. Quality 100 provided higher numerical fidelity but nearly doubled storage without evidence of a necessary downstream benefit.
reviewer_notes: Pilot CLOSED / PASS. JPEG quality 95 is locked for Phase 2D.1B-Full. Full controlled-scope conversion is authorized. This decision does not claim downstream detector superiority, clinical equivalence, or dataset training readiness.
